title: feat(gcode): add the camcraft-gcode reader crate for 3-axis RS-274 and ISO 6983 programs
body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds the new crate `crates/gcode` (`camcraft-gcode`). The crate reads RS-274/NGC and ISO 6983 3-axis milling programs. It gives `cl::Toolpath` sections and a 1-based line map. It refuses unsupported words by name and line number.

- The crate depends on `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-geometry` and `thiserror` only.
- It decodes the modal groups, `I`/`J`/`K` and `R` arcs in `G17`/`G18`/`G19`, and the canned cycles `G73`, `G81`, `G82`, `G83`, `G84`, `G85`, `G86`, `G89` with `G98`/`G99` and `L`.
- It splits sections at `T`/`M6`. It reads `S`, `M3`-`M5`, `M0`-`M2`, `M30`, `G4`, `G61`, `G64`, `G53`, `G28` and `G30`.
- It refuses `G41`/`G42`, macros (`G65`, `M98`, `#`), probing (`G31`, `G38.2`), `R` full circles, a missing `G20`/`G21`, a missing reference position, and `A`/`B`/`C`.

Sources: RS-274/NGC (NISTIR 6556), ISO 6983, and the public controller documents that `crates/gcode/src/dialect.rs` names for the dwell and arc presets. No other parser code was used.

## Held work

- Commit `711314efd` by Mike Kinney, from `mkinney:issue/2217-camcraft-gcode`. It has the crate, its 9 tests, the decision file and the gate plan entries.
- This PR keeps that commit and its author unchanged. A merge commit (`db23cf9bd`) joins it to main `60376ccbb`.

## Added after the held commit

- `db23cf9bd` merge: the conflict resolution (next section).
- `75b33ace3` `test(xtask)`: two xtask tests of main list the crates by hand. `heavy_plan_tests::reach_follows_the_crate_dependencies` now expects `gcode` in the reach of `geometry`. `step_tests::batch_prebuild_leaves_suite_steps_fresh_with_truck_dev_dep` now writes a stub `crates/gcode`. `Cargo.lock` takes the version `0.25.0` for `camcraft-gcode`.
- `92627aef0` `test(gcode)`:
  - Each gcode suite has a `Gate map: covers camcraft_gcode::{..}` line. Quick then selects the suites for a change in each `crates/gcode/src` module.
  - The new suite `degenerate_input` checks malformed programs. Each one gives a value or a refusal, with no panic and no hang.
  - The decision file records the merge.

## Conflict resolution

All three conflicts were lists. No logic hunk had a conflict.

- Root `Cargo.toml`: the `members` line has main's `"crates/gpu"` and the held `"crates/gcode"` (after `"crates/cl"`). The `camcraft-gcode` workspace dependency merged without a conflict.
- `xtask/src/plan.rs`: `BATCH_CRATES`, `ALL_CRATES` and `CLIPPY` have `"gcode"` after `"cl"` and main's `"gpu"` after `"app"`.
- `xtask/src/tests.rs`: the release step count keeps main's known-fail `checks` term. It uses the held `plan::ALL_CRATES.len()` in place of the fixed `10`.
- `Cargo.lock` merged without a conflict.

## New crate edges

- `camcraft-gcode -> camcraft-cl`: `ArcPlane`, `Cycle`, `CycleKind`, `MoveKind`, `PathBuilder`, `Toolpath`, `lattice`.
- `camcraft-gcode -> camcraft-geometry`: `geo2d::Point2`, `Point3`, `units::{from_display, Unit, MM_PER_INCH}`.
- `docs/decisions/2217-camcraft-gcode.md` gives the imported items, the reason that a caller cannot pass the values in, and the rebuild impact. No crate depends on `camcraft-gcode` yet.

## Review fixes (review of `92627aef0`)

Commit `cb4acfadd` fixes the 11 review items. The merge `e0cc82c99` takes current `origin/main` (`44903e15e`); it merged with no conflict. The decision file has one entry for each item.

1. G73/G83: each peck must move deeper, at most 4096 pecks; one cycle block emits at most 100 000 moves.
2. Numeric domain: lengths and points are finite and inside +/-1e6 mm after conversion and arithmetic; caller options are checked. New errors `OutOfRange` and `InvalidOptions`.
3. One frame rule for G54-G59, G28, G30 and G53 (cursor moves into the new frame; unknown origins are refused).
4. Canned cycles run in G17 only; G18/G19 cycles and plane changes in a cycle are refused.
5. Spindle, coolant, length- and work-offset changes after a move start a new section.
6. Cycle state holds over repeated cycle codes and bare blocks.
7. G89 feeds out to the clear level.
8. G90.01 is refused; G90.10 is G90.1.
9. Haas `P10` is ms, `P10.` is s.
10. The gpu clippy failure is fixed on main by `4cc0638ee`; the merge brings it in. No gpu change in this PR.
11. One directory suite: `crates/gcode/tests/parse/`.

## Tests

All tests are in one directory suite, `crates/gcode/tests/parse/` (`main.rs` holds the Gate map and the shared 5 s time-limit helper). No new top-level test binary. The `#[test]` count went from 10 to 37.

- `three_axis` (was `gcode_3axis.rs`, 7 tests). `modal_groups_track_and_sections_split_on_tool_changes` now has G55/G56 origins and pins the start of tool 2 in the G56 frame.
- `dialects_and_planes` (2), `degenerate_input` (1): moved, unchanged.
- `cycle_bounds` (item 1): `peck_cycles_near_1e20_refuse_and_never_spin`, `peck_cycles_without_f64_progress_refuse_by_line`, `peck_count_over_4096_per_hole_refuses`, `expansion_over_pecks_and_repeats_is_bounded`.
- `numeric_domain` (item 2): `huge_finite_axis_words_refuse_by_line`, `incremental_sum_past_the_domain_refuses`, `huge_arc_radius_refuses_instead_of_a_straight_move`, `huge_feed_after_inch_conversion_refuses`, `values_inside_the_domain_still_parse`, `bad_caller_options_refuse_before_line_one`.
- `frames` (item 3): `g54_to_g55_keeps_the_machine_move`, `nonzero_origins_move_the_cursor_on_every_axis`, `offset_change_after_motion_without_origins_refuses`, `g28_and_g30_use_the_machine_origin_of_the_active_offset`, `g28_without_a_known_work_origin_refuses`.
- `cycle_rules` (items 4, 6, 7): `cycles_in_g18_and_g19_refuse_before_expansion`, `plane_change_while_a_cycle_is_active_refuses`, `repeated_cycle_code_keeps_sticky_r_and_z`, `g98_initial_level_survives_g99_and_repeated_codes`, `incremental_sticky_depths_repeat_from_the_same_levels`, `g89_feeds_to_the_clear_level_and_g85_feeds_to_r`.
- `sections` (item 5): `spindle_start_after_the_first_move_starts_a_section`, `every_state_change_between_moves_is_kept`, `a_repeated_equal_state_word_keeps_one_section`.
- `codes_and_dwell` (items 8, 9): `decimal_codes_keep_their_place_value`, `haas_g04_p_without_a_point_is_ms_and_with_a_point_is_s`, `haas_cycle_dwell_uses_the_same_rule`.

## Gate

### Final result on `16e1ff8c7` (the current head)

- Command: `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`, run on the head `16e1ff8c7` itself. Started 2026-11-24 00:37 UTC. Toolchain `rustc 1.99.1` (stable). Budget: 10 jobs.
- Plan base: the merge base `db3bb1f7f` (the last main merged into this branch). The plan was the batch plan, because `Cargo.lock` changed.
- Result: **1196 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled** (wall 50.2 min). The `clippy -D warnings` step (all crates, `camcraft-gpu` included) passed. Logs: `gate-logs/quick-20261124-003742` in the author's worktree.
- Current upstream main is `29bb9e9a2`. The trial merge of `16e1ff8c7` with it is clean (GitHub: mergeable, clean; the review of `16e1ff8c7` reports the same).

### Earlier gate records (kept for history)

The head `16e1ff8c7` is `36e69fe74` (merge of `origin/main` `db3bb1f7f`) plus one docs-only commit to the decision file; the results below are on `36e69fe74` and earlier heads. Toolchain: `rustc 1.99.1` (stable; the repository pins no toolchain, and the runners use "a stable rustc"). Budget: 10 jobs.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on `c22228cd1` (merge of main `44903e15e`): batch plan, because `Cargo.lock` changed. Result: 1192 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled.
  - `clippy -D warnings` (all crates, `camcraft-gpu` included): ok. Main fixed the gpu lint in `4cc0638ee`; this PR does not change `crates/gpu`.
  - `gcode suites: lib`, `gcode suites: parse`: ok.
  - The 1 failed step: `app suites: rotary_verify` (`a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius`, left 2110, right 2064). Main `44903e15e` was red on this test (#3774). PR #3786 fixed the pin on main.
- Then `origin/main` `db3bb1f7f` (with #3786) merged without a conflict. On the final head `36e69fe74`:
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --failed gate-logs/quick-20261123-234012`: 1 step (`app suites: rotary_verify`), 0 failed.
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-gcode`: 37 passed, 0 failed.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-gcode -p camcraft-gpu --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.
  - `cargo test -p xtask lanes_tests::batch_executor_overlaps_lanes_runs_isolated_alone_and_writes_timings`: pass. (In a full `cargo test -p xtask` run at load 110, this timing test failed one time; it passes alone. This PR does not change it.)
- An earlier quick run on `c22228cd1` stopped at the app build with `No space left on device` (the shared disk was full). It is not a code result.
- Rust 1.90 (the `rust-version`) was also tried for clippy: its clippy flags `needless_range_loop` in main's `crates/kernel/src/mesh_bound_spline.rs:146`, which the runners' clippy does not flag. Thus 1.90 is not the clippy of the gate.
- Full heavy lanes: not run (the rule of #3556). The crate has no heavy test.

## Not exercised

- No caller uses the crate yet. The post round trip and the simulator are in the follow-up issues.
- The controller presets (`fanuc`, `haas`, `tormach`, `grblhal`, `tinyg`, `carvera`) were not compared with a real controller.
- A heavy lane is not required: the crate has no heavy test.
- Canned cycles in G18/G19 are refused, not mapped (decision item 4).

## Unblocks

#2218, #2219, #2222, #2227
